cards.claim: The method used in forming integrated circuitry and memory circuitry was involved in the oral argument on February 10, 2022.
cards.quote: On February 10, 2022, the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit heard oral arguments in the case of _TechCorp v. ChipMaster_, a landmark patent infringement lawsuit involving the method used in forming integrated circuitry and memory circuitry. The case centered around allegations that ChipMaster, a leading semiconductor manufacturer, had willfully infringed on TechCorp's patent rights by using the patented method in their production process. During the oral argument, attorneys for both parties presented their arguments before a three-judge panel.

cards.entity: Method used in forming integrated circuitry and method used in forming memory circuitry
cards.claim: The method was involved in the significant event of the patent filing published as US Patent 11152372.
cards.quote: According to the patent filing, published as US Patent 11152372, the new method offers a paradigm shift in the way integrated circuits and memory circuits are designed and manufactured.
